Recorded claim:
The default l10n-bump configuration needs a repository URL as well as release configurations, because Try can exercise the default branch. Split localization must route toolkit/devtools and comm strings to their correct repositories; Git source takes precedence over legacy hg settings. Entries298/312 and current configs support this. Current URLs use firefox-l10n and thunderbird-l10n Git sources; historical Mercurial URLs are obsolete.

title: Recorded lesson: Give default localization jobs an explicit source and respect Git migration
